dedupe_keys.name: mapa de trafico of the spanish state road network traffic speeds and accidents plan nacional de aforos

description: The Traffic Map (Mapa de Tráfico) is the annual publication of the most relevant information on traffic, speeds and accidents on Spain's State Road Network (RCE). It results from the National Counting Plan (Plan Nacional de Aforos), carried out annually in Spain since 1960. A web traffic viewer reproduces the traffic GIS and basic data of the Directorate General of Roads on official maps of the National Geographic Institute, and the publication adds complementary traffic information; it fulfils article 6 of Road Law 37/2015 on informing citizens. Coverage: the State Road Network. Format and access: free annual maps and a web viewer. Licence and cost: free; no reuse licence is stated on the page. Caveats: regional and local roads are not included. It supports network flow and capacity planning studies of Spanish highways. It relates to the Spanish national access point and the OTLE observatory in the catalogue.
